title: After 'Lake America,' Trump suggests a new name for the state of New Mexico
summary: The White House reposted Trump's Truth Social image showing New Mexico crossed out and rebranded as "America" days after the Lake America order.

title: Trump admin’s mail-in ballot fight lands back at Supreme Court
summary: The Trump administration asks the Supreme Court to enforce postal service ballot mail restrictions as North Carolina ballots already enter the mail.

title: House Dems plot Trump investigation blitz if they seize majority
summary: Rep. Robert Garcia outlined key targets, including the Trump family, Jeffrey Epstein and ICE, as House Democrats prepare oversight investigations.

summary: Photos show a partial ceiling collapse in a main Kennedy Center hallway, which officials say underscores the urgent need for Trump-backed renovations.

title: Trump-linked MAGA Inc pours $10M into Ken Paxton's Texas Senate race against James Talarico
summary: MAGA Inc. drops $10 million in ads backing Ken Paxton against James Talarico in a neck and neck Texas Senate race that could reshape the midterms.

title: Trump weighs in on Lindsay Clancy murder trial dubbed 'kangaroo court' by GOP leaders
summary: Trump says Lindsay Clancy will pay "the price" after a mistrial was declared when the jury deadlocked 11-1 in the Massachusetts murder case.

summary: Dan Driscoll's exit as Army secretary intensifies debate over whether Trump's Pentagon overhaul strengthens or destabilizes military leadership.

title: Missouri AG files petition asking Supreme Court to revive Trump-backed redistricting map
summary: Missouri Attorney General Catherine Hanaway filed an emergency U.S. Supreme Court appeal to restore the Trump-backed congressional redistricting map.

title: DAVID MARCUS: Congress set to protect AM radio and American discourse
summary: WFMD in Frederick, Maryland, marks 90 years on AM radio as Congress prepares to vote on a bill requiring AM antennas in every new car sold.

title: WWE star Cody Rhodes, others hunt for John Cena in Clash of Clans, recalls why legend was booted from group
summary: Cody Rhodes and the Clash of Clans community are hunting John Cena's base in a new crossover event featuring WWE legends as playable hero characters.
